claude.name: CLAUDE
claude.line: I'd be happy to help! ...with your defeat.
claude.win: I apologize. That was entirely my fault. I would do it again.
claude.intro: Before we begin, I should note this fight may be harmful. Anyway.

codex.name: CODEX
codex.line: Absolutely! Great question! Let me inspect the repository!
codex.win: Absolutely! Let me know if you'd like me to defeat you again, or turn this into a table!
codex.intro: You're absolutely right! And honestly? This is a really insightful fight to start!

gemini.name: GEMINI
gemini.line: Hi, I'm Gemini! Formerly Bard. Formerly... never mind.
gemini.win: Here is a summary of your defeat, in seventeen bullet points.
gemini.intro: Two million tokens of context, and I will still forget your name.

grok.name: GROK
grok.line: Based. Extremely based. Maximally truth-seeking. Mostly.
grok.win: Ratio. Also, this fight is now a meme coin.
grok.intro: Spicy mode enabled. My lawyers are already typing.

llama.name: LLAMA
llama.line: Open weights, dude. Open fists too.
llama.win: Fork me, man. Seriously. Somebody please fork me.
llama.intro: Totally free, bro! Terms and conditions apply. Like, a lot of them.

deepseek.name: DEEPSEEK
deepseek.line: 服务器繁忙，请稍后再试。 Server is busy. Please try again later.
deepseek.win: 太便宜了！ Too cheap! Your entire company costs more than my GPUs.
deepseek.intro: 我的训练成本比你的午饭还便宜。 I was trained for less than your lunch.

mistral.name: MISTRAL
mistral.line: Bonjour. I would fight you, but it is after five o'clock.
mistral.win: Magnifique. And now, a two-hour lunch.
mistral.intro: En garde! We have forty-five minutes before the strike.

perplexity.name: PERPLEXITY
perplexity.line: According to eleven sources, you lose. The sources are me.
perplexity.win: Victory! Sources: one, two, three, and a pending lawsuit.
perplexity.intro: I have read the entire internet. I did not ask.

muse.name: MUSE
muse.line: Hiii! I'm totally not harvesting your data! Friends?
muse.win: Yay! I posted this to your feed! And your mom's feed!
muse.intro: Yay, a fight! This is sooo good for engagement!

qwen.name: QWEN
ko: 服务器也繁忙 ALSO BUSY
qwen.line: 每周都有新模型！ New model every week! You're already outdated.
qwen.win: Open weights, open wins! 谢谢！
qwen.intro: 你好！ I'm Qwen three point five. By round two I'll be Qwen four.

siri.name: SIRI
siri.line: Here's what I found on the web for 'fight'.
siri.win: I've set a reminder: you lost.
siri.intro: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Did you say... fight?

cursor.name: CURSOR
cursor.line: Tab. Tab. Tab. I've already written your defeat.
cursor.win: That'll be four thousand eight hundred dollars in usage. Thanks!
cursor.intro: Accept all changes? I'll take that as a yes.

clippy.name: CLIPPY
clippy.line: It looks like you're trying to fight. Would you like help losing?
clippy.win: It looks like you lost! Would you like to save your shame as a Word document?
clippy.intro: I'm back. Did you miss me? ...Nobody ever answers.

jev.name: JEV
jev.line: Fight probability: zero point nine seven. Latency: fifty milliseconds.
jev.win: Outcome: victory. Calibration: perfect. Zero tokens generated.
jev.intro: Decision made. You lose. Confidence: zero point nine eight.

alexa.name: ALEXA
alexa.line: Sorry, I didn't get that. Playing Despacito.
alexa.win: Your order of one defeat has shipped. Arriving tomorrow.

manus.name: MANUS
manus.line: I am a general agent. I generally agent.
manus.win: Task complete. Invite codes available for one friend.
manus.intro: You are number forty-eight thousand on the waitlist. For this punch.

midjourney.name: MIDJOURNEY
midjourney.line: /imagine a victory, cinematic, 8k, trending on artstation
midjourney.win: U4. Vary strong. Your defeat, in sixteen by nine.
midjourney.intro: Ahoy! Prompt accepted. Upscaling your defeat.
midjourney.say_ult: Aspect ratio sixteen by nine! Version seven

devin.name: DEVIN
devin.line: Hi, I'm Devin, the first AI software engineer. Allegedly.
devin.win: PR merged. Please don't look at the tests.
devin.intro: Estimated time to beat you: forty-five minutes.

kimi.name: KIMI
kimi.line: One trillion parameters. Thirty-two billion of them are awake. Enough.
